name: fetch_url
description: Fetch and read the text content of a public web page with SSRF and redirect-hop validation. Use this after web_search or when the user shares a URL. Returns Readability-style extracted text, metadata, image candidates, URL/title provenance, and a suggested citation. It does not download binary assets; use download_asset for supported image URLs.

url.description: The URL to fetch (must be http:// or https://).

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return. Default: 5000.

mode.description: Extraction mode. auto tries Readability, then main/body text, then metadata. readability prefers article extraction. text skips Readability. metadata returns page metadata. assets focuses on image candidates.

include_assets.description: Whether to include image candidates from metadata, picture/source, srcset, and img tags. Default: true for HTML pages.
